methodology.triState: reasonable true = defensible concrete entry supported; false = specific supported negative for proposed entry; null = partial positive/negative evidence without enough basis for either. Null is not rejection.
methodology.certainty: Medium describes confidence in this limited evidence and null recommendation, not high certainty of commercial success.
methodology.metrics: Cached Semrush estimates are distinct from current real Google observations; Volume/KD/Trends/KGR gates delegated to root.
